newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE recognises Taleban Afghan government.
newsitem.headline: UAE recognises Taleban Afghan government.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates on Tuesday recognised the Taleban Islamic movement's government in Afghanistan, the official news agency WAM said.

"The UAE also hopes the Taleban government would be able to restore security and stability and end bloodshed among the brethren in Afghanistan," it quoted a ministry of foreign affairs source as saying.
The source stressed that the oil-rich Gulf Arab state wanted to develop bilateral ties with Afghanistan.

Saudi Arabia on Monday recognised the Taleban government after weekend military gains by its Islamic militia which tightened its grip on northern Afghanistan as routed opposition warlord General Abdul Rashid Dostum fled to Turkey. The movement captured the capital Kabul last September.
Pakistan recognised the Taleban government on Sunday.
